{"description":"hire-nmh/chrome-manifest.json line 7:
    "allowed_origins": [ "chrome-extension://PLACEHOLDER_EXTENSION_ID/" ]

Installed as-is, Chrome rejects every connection to the native messaging host — the manifest parses but matches no extension. Nothing in the repo substitutes the real id: no Makefile install target, no script, and no README instructions for either manifest.

Both manifests also hardcode "path": "/usr/local/bin/hire-nmh", which contradicts systemd/hired.service installing binaries to %h/.cargo/bin, and neither manifest is referenced by any build or install step, so nothing keeps the two files in sync with each other (chrome uses allowed_origins, firefox uses allowed_extensions — that difference is correct and intentional).

Either add an install target that templates the extension id and binary path, or document the manual substitution in README.md."}
